verdict.rationale: Evidence item docs-8 comes from Google's Discovery endpoint (googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis/drive/v3/rest). That endpoint is a machine-readable description of the Drive v3 API and includes OAuth scope definitions, so it counts as an OpenAPI-equivalent spec. The pack never describes it as a downloadable spec or documents its schema. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at the standard developers.google.com paths, so the spec exists only in Google's proprietary Discovery format. Missing for 10: native OpenAPI/Swagger spec, first-party documentation describing the Discovery document as a downloadable spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of using it for tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
